press_references.value: Measured Launches Omnichannel Media Planning Tool Powered by Causal Media Mix Modeling

product_launches.description: Measured has launched its new Omnichannel Media Plan Optimizer, a planning tool powered by causal Media Mix Modeling, designed to help marketers optimize media spend and link investments to business outcomes.

overview_description.description: Measured is the pioneer and leader of incrementality-based media measurement and optimization. Since 2017, leading brands have used our AI-powered, all-in-one platform to manage, test, plan, and optimize over $20 billion in full-funnel media investments. Measured’s unique combination of automated experimentation, media mix modeling, and industry-leading expertise helps marketers prove the incremental impact of their advertising and maximize ROI with unmatched ease, accuracy, and efficiency.
